thread:
jess: Quick note  observed a 2.8x uptick in per-tenant embed route bills after enabling broader preflight sampling last night. saw it in the cost dashboard at 02:00 UTC.
tyler: Which sampling flag was changed? was that the dim-hist retention flip?
jess: We increased preflight sampling from 0.5% -> 4% to get more dim diversity. timeline matches.
anika: Not surprising. more preflight samples => more detected mixed-dim payloads => splitter does extra RPCs. That multiplies internal tokens.
pm-lina: Oof. any particular tenants driving the spike? product needs a short note for account ops.
ops-bot: quick query: embed_splitter_invocations by tenant (last 6h) shows tenant-acme + tenant-beta responsible for ~70% of delta.
tyler: Do we have a safe rollback plan? we should be able to revert sample rate quickly while we design smarter telemetry.
jess: short-term: I propose lowering to 1.5% and pausing sampling for tenants in "trial" tier. long-term: add a small preflight-estimator API that returns a cost estimate without triggering splitter behavior.
anika: +1 on estimator. sketch: POST /v1/embeddings/preflight/estimate -> returns est_units, would run cheap heuristics (no actual split). if prob_split high, client or ingress can choose different route.
pm-lina: Product loves that idea; they want console to show an "estimated cost" line in the query preview and an explanation if estimator predicts fragmentation.
tyler: Important: estimator must be conservative and fast. We can't run full serialization. maybe use header-only stats: num_inputs, avg_bytes, dims_hint[] and an O(1) cost table.
jess: agree. also we should store estimator predictions in telemetry (sampled) so we can later compute estimator accuracy. storage delta small if we sample predictions at 1% of requests.
anika: For rollout: canary the estimator for 10k requests in us-west, compare real splitter invocations vs predicted. if accuracy > 0.9, flip on.
ops-bot: created rollout job r-5573 (canary us-west). will surface metrics after 1h.
tyler: Console UX: show est_units with a tooltip "est. token units if split not triggered" and if estimator indicates high prob_split, show a yellow badge "may split" with suggestions: "try smaller batches" or "request dims_hint".
pm-lina: Also add a note in billing UI explaining estimator is preliminary during canary and costs may adjust. want to avoid surprise.
jess: Telemetry-wise: need to add fields we persist on sampled preflights: payload_size_bytes, dims_mode, tenant_tier, estimator_outcome. ops team: estimate impact?
anika: Rough numbers: storing extra 4 fields at 1% sampling increases observability store by ~12% monthly. we can absorb but will request a quota increment for long-term.
tyler: Automation: add a guard on the sampler rollout: if overall splitter amplification (splitter_invocations / sampled_requests) increases > 2x inside 2 hours of config change, auto-revert the sampling flag. we have rollout automation infra for that.
ops-bot: alert rule created: embed.splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 120m of config-change (alert id: E-3021).
pm-lina: Great. can we also expose a console changelog entry when sampling configs change so finance and CS see it?
jess: yeah I'll add a small banner with changelog link and a "who to contact" link.
tyler: Next: API contract for estimator. I'll draft a minimal JSON schema. quick draft below:

```
POST /v1/embeddings/preflight/estimate
{
  "num_inputs": 50,
  "avg_input_bytes": 1200,
  "dims_hint": [512],
  "strict": false
}

200 OK
{
  "est_units": 1234,
  "prob_split": 0.72,
  "reason_codes": ["mixed_dims", "large_batch"]
}
```

anika: That looks good. add "est_confidence" (0-1) to help console visuals. also include a "recommended_action" string for quick UX text.
jess: Good call. I'll update the sketch. who owns the PR?
tyler: I'll own the API PR plus a tiny microbench harness to show estimator latency < 5ms p95.
pm-lina: I'll coordinate the console mockups with devex. want to show the badge and cost estimate in both the quick-run and saved-query flows.
ops-bot: canary metrics after 30m: estimator prediction precision 0.88 (p=0.76, r=0.91), avg estimator latency 2.1ms p95 3.8ms.
anika: precision OK but we should bias estimator to under-predict split probability (conservative) so we don't hide fragmentation risk. add that note to PR.
jess: action items captured: TYLER -> API PR + perf bench; ANIKA -> telemetry storage calc + obs ticket; JESS -> banner + billing note; PM-LINA -> console mocks; OPS-BOT -> monitor alert E-3021 during rollout.
tyler: filing PR now and tagging reviewers.
pm-lina: timeline: aim to ship estimator canary next week, console follow-up in the next sprint.
anika: one more: make sure splitter logs include a "preflight_estimator_id" when a request had an estimate so we can correlate. small runtime change.
tyler: will add the header propagation and a small trace tag.
ops-bot: logging change rolled to canary (job id L-778).
jess: Thanks everyone. we'll re-evaluate after the week of canary and adjust sampling policy accordingly. :thumbsup:
